mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_log (txn_id, msg_type, direction, masked_payload, response_code, elapsed_ms) VALUES (#{txnId}, #{msgType}, #{direction}, #{maskedPayload}, #{responseCode}, #{elapsedMs})
mapper.select: SELECT txn_id, msg_type, direction, masked_payload, response_code, elapsed_ms FROM message_log WHERE txn_id = #{txnId} ORDER BY log_id
